notes: One entry per padel test. The engine reads this file to pick the athlete's top 3 priorities, their role lines, fixes, role drills and retest window. Gemini only rewords the text it is given. Scores come from the existing scoring engine, unchanged. Left/right and ratio rules use the library's own percentages on the raw left/right results. Rules marked proposed need DPT sign-off; engine_note says where the engine's data can't follow the library exactly.

target.label: Gold
target.text: Tier target is the Gold line (score 75). Priorities are ranked by score points below 75, biggest gap first; ties keep library order.

plan.text: One combined 6-week plan: every selected fix runs from week 1. A fix shorter than 6 weeks switches to that test's maintain fix (where the library has one) for the remaining weeks.

rebuild.text: Want to be coached through it? PeakPerformance Rebuild is a one-month plan with two sessions a week with our team: testing, healing and strengthening.

tests.name: 10m Sprint
tests.what_we_measured: How fast you cover 10 metres from a standing start, the length of one side of the court.

role_lines.drive: You cover the middle of the court and chase balls coming off the side glass. A quicker first few steps means reaching them balanced instead of stretching.
role_lines.reves: You chase most of the lobs that go over your partner and you. Speed decides whether you get behind the ball or let it run off the back glass.
role_lines.every: Padel is won at the net. After every lob you have to sprint back in and take it again before your opponents do.

rules.text: Score below tier target → show Fix A: first-step power.
At or above Gold → show Fix B: keep it sharp.

A.title: first-step power
exercises: Falling starts over 5 metres: 6 reps, full rest.
Split-step then sprint on a partner's call: 6 reps.
Split squats: 3 sets of 8 each leg.

B.title: keep it sharp
exercises: Split-step reaction sprints over 5 metres: 6 reps.

role_drills.drive: Sprint from the middle to the side glass and back: 6 reps.
role_drills.reves: Turn and chase: a partner lobs over you, turn and run it down before it reaches the back glass. 8 reps.
role_drills.every: Back-to-net sprints: from the back glass to the net and split-step. 6 reps.

tests.name: 5-0-5 Agility Test
tests.what_we_measured: How quickly you sprint, stop, turn 180° and sprint back out.

role_lines.drive: You often have to stop, turn and cover the middle after your partner is pulled wide. A sharp turn closes that gap before it's attacked.
role_lines.reves: Balls off the back glass and the corner change direction late. Stopping and turning fast lets you play them instead of being beaten by the bounce.
role_lines.every: Every point is short bursts with sudden stops. The faster you brake and re-accelerate, the more balls you reach on balance.

rules.text: Time slower than tier target → show Fix A: brake and turn.
Slower turning off one foot than the other (if timed both ways, more than 5%, proposed) → also show Fix B: even both turns.
rules.engine_note: The 5-0-5 is not in the current padel scoring battery, and one time is recorded, not one per turning foot.

A.title: brake and turn
exercises: Deceleration drills: sprint 5 metres, stop in two steps and hold. 6 reps.
5-0-5 practice at 80% effort, focusing on a low turn: 6 reps.
Lateral lunges: 3 sets of 8 each side.

B.title: even both turns
exercises: Two extra turns off your weaker foot in each session.

role_drills.drive: Cover-the-middle shuffle: shuffle wide, plant and return to centre. 3 sets of 6.
role_drills.reves: Back-glass exits: a partner feeds into the corner, you turn and play it out. 10 reps.
role_drills.every: Partner-call change of direction over 5 metres: 8 reps.

tests.name: Ruler Drop Test
tests.what_we_measured: How far a dropped ruler falls before you catch it. Shorter is faster.

role_lines.drive: Balls through the middle come at you fast and low. Quick reactions let you cover the middle and punch the volley rather than just block it.
role_lines.reves: You face more smashes and fast balls off the glass. Reaction is how early you read the bounce and get your racket in place.
role_lines.every: At the net, exchanges happen in fractions of a second. The faster player wins the reflex volley.

rules.text: Catch distance worse than tier target → show Fix A: sharpen reactions.
At or above Gold → show Fix B: keep it sharp.

A.title: sharpen reactions
exercises: Reaction ball against a wall: 3 rounds of 60 seconds.
Partner drops: a partner drops a ball without warning; catch it before the second bounce. 3 sets of 10.

B.title: keep it sharp
exercises: Fast volley rallies at the net once a week.

role_drills.drive: Partner feeds fast balls at your body through the middle; volley each one. 20 balls.
role_drills.reves: Defend smashes off the back glass from a partner's feed. 15 balls.
role_drills.every: Quick-fire volleys at the net with a partner, both at the net. 3 rounds of 30 seconds.

tests.retest_note: Reaction improves fastest, so it's often the first stat that moves.

tests.name: Overhead Squat
tests.what_we_measured: How well your ankles, hips, upper back and shoulders work together as you squat with your arms overhead.

role_lines.drive: Low balls at your feet, especially the chiquita and low volleys, need you to get down without losing your posture.
role_lines.reves: Bandejas, víboras and smashes need your arms overhead while your trunk stays upright. Tight shoulders or a stiff upper back force your lower back to arch instead.
role_lines.every: Defending from the back means staying low for long rallies. Good squat mechanics let you stay low without tiring your back.

rules.text: Heels lifting or knees caving → show Fix A: ankles and hips.
Arms dropping forward or the lower back arching → show Fix B: shoulders and upper back.
Clean pattern → show Fix C: maintain.

tests.missing_observation_text: The fault pattern was not recorded at testing, so the fix is chosen with your coach: ankles and hips, or shoulders and upper back.

A.title: ankles and hips
exercises: Knee-to-wall ankle stretch: 2 sets of 10 each side.
Goblet squat holds at the bottom: 3 holds of 30 seconds.
Banded lateral walks: 2 sets of 12 steps each way.

B.title: shoulders and upper back
exercises: Foam roller extensions on the upper back: 10 slow reps.
Wall slides: 2 sets of 10.
Open book stretch: 2 sets of 10 each side.

C.title: maintain
exercises: Overhead squats with a stick in every warm-up: 1 set of 8.

role_drills.drive: Low-ball feeds: a partner feeds at your feet; stay low and play them back. 15 balls.
role_drills.reves: Shadow bandejas, keeping your chest tall: 2 sets of 10.
role_drills.every: Defensive stance holds from the back glass: 3 holds of 20 seconds.

tests.name: Trunk Rotation
tests.what_we_measured: How far your upper body turns to each side while your hips stay still.

role_lines.drive: Your forehand and your drive off the glass get their power from turning your shoulders against your hips. Limited rotation means swinging with just your arm.
role_lines.reves: The víbora and the smash are rotation shots. More turn means more spin and pace without forcing your shoulder.
role_lines.every: Getting out of the corner and playing balls off the back glass means turning fast while your feet are still set.

rules.text: One side more than 10% less than the other (proposed) → show Fix A: even it out.
Both sides below tier target → show Fix B: open up the upper back.

A.title: even it out
exercises: Open book stretch toward the tighter side: 2 sets of 10, plus one extra set on that side.
Seated rotations with a stick across your shoulders: 2 sets of 10 each side.

B.title: open up the upper back
exercises: Foam roller extensions on the upper back: 10 slow reps.
Open book: 2 sets of 10 each side.
Half-kneeling band rotations: 3 sets of 10 each side.

role_drills.drive: Med ball side throws from a forehand stance: 3 sets of 6.
role_drills.reves: Shadow víboras, pausing at full shoulder turn: 2 sets of 10.
role_drills.every: Back-glass feeds: let the ball come off the glass, turn and play it out. 10 each side.

tests.name: Single Leg Stand, Eyes Closed
tests.what_we_measured: How steady you stay on one leg with your eyes closed, on each side. This tests the balance system in your ankle and body, not your eyesight.

role_lines.drive: Lunging wide for balls off the side glass ends on one leg. Better balance means a controlled shot and a quick recovery.
role_lines.reves: Landing after a smash or a jumping víbora is a one-leg landing while you're looking up at the ball.
role_lines.every: Padel is full of quick stops on one foot, and ankle sprains are among the most common injuries in the sport. Good balance is your first protection.

rules.text: Sway above tier target on either leg → show Fix A: build balance.
rules.engine_note: The engine records time held (seconds) per leg, not sway, so each leg's score is used.

rules.text: One leg clearly worse than the other (more than 20% more sway, proposed) → also show Fix B: even it out. Ask about past ankle sprains on that side.
rules.engine_note: Sway isn't recorded: one leg's time held more than 20% below the other is used instead.
rules.coach_note: Ask about past ankle sprains on that side.

A.title: build balance
exercises: Single-leg stands, eyes open then closed: 3 holds of 30 seconds each leg.
Single-leg stands on a cushion or folded towel: 3 holds of 30 seconds each leg.
Single-leg reaches in three directions: 2 sets of 6 each leg.

B.title: even it out
exercises: One extra hold on your weaker leg in every exercise.

role_drills.drive: Wide lunge and hold on one leg for 2 seconds before recovering: 3 sets of 6 each side.
role_drills.reves: Small jump, land on one leg and hold for 3 seconds: 3 sets of 5 each leg.
role_drills.every: Single-leg stand while bouncing a ball on your racket: 3 holds of 20 seconds each leg.

tests.name: Shoulder External Rotation Strength
tests.what_we_measured: The strength of the muscles at the back of each shoulder that rotate your arm outward.

role_lines.drive: Your forehand and serve are fast arm swings that have to stop cleanly. The back of the shoulder does the braking, rally after rally.
role_lines.reves: You hit most of the overheads: bandejas, víboras and smashes. Each one loads the back of the shoulder hard. Weakness here is how shoulder pain builds over a season.
role_lines.every: A strong, balanced shoulder lets you swing freely without your body quietly holding back. It also takes load off the elbow, which is where padel elbow starts.

rules.text: Strength relative to bodyweight below tier target on your racket arm → show Fix A: strengthen the back of the shoulder.
rules.engine_note: The racket arm's score against VALD's age-and-sex bands is used, not strength relative to bodyweight.

rules.text: Racket arm more than 10% weaker than the other arm (proposed) → also show Fix B: close the gap.
Strong and balanced → show Fix C: maintain.

A.title: strengthen the back of the shoulder
exercises: Side-lying external rotation with a light dumbbell: 3 sets of 12–15.
Band external rotation with the arm at shoulder height (90/90): 3 sets of 12.
Prone Y and T raises: 2 sets of 10 in the warm-up.

B.title: close the gap
exercises: One extra set on your racket arm for each exercise.

C.title: maintain
exercises: Band external rotation, 2 sets of 15, twice a week.

role_drills.drive: Band external rotation as part of your warm-up before every match.
role_drills.reves: Limit full-power smashes in practice to 20–30 per session while you build strength.
role_drills.every: Stop and tell us if you feel pain on the outside of your elbow; don't play through it.

tests.name: Hip Abduction Strength
tests.what_we_measured: The strength of the muscles on the outside of each hip that push your leg out to the side.

role_lines.drive: Pushing off sideways to cover the middle starts here. Strong outer hips mean a faster first lateral step.
role_lines.reves: Lunging toward the side glass on your backhand side loads your outside leg. These muscles keep that knee straight instead of letting it cave in.
role_lines.every: They keep your pelvis level and your knee pointing straight on every lunge and stop, which protects your knees.

rules.text: Strength relative to bodyweight below tier target → show Fix A: build hip strength.
rules.engine_note: The engine's score against VALD's age-and-sex bands is used, not strength relative to bodyweight.

rules.text: One side more than 10% weaker than the other (proposed) → also show Fix B: close the gap.
Strong and even → show Fix C: maintain.

A.title: build hip strength
exercises: Side-lying leg raises: 3 sets of 15 each side, slow on the way down.
Banded lateral walks: 3 sets of 12 steps each way.
Side planks with top-leg raise: 3 sets of 8 each side.

B.title: close the gap
exercises: One extra set of each exercise on the weaker side.

C.title: maintain
exercises: Banded lateral walks in every warm-up.

role_drills.drive: Lateral push-offs: shuffle and push off to the centre line. 3 sets of 6 each way.
role_drills.reves: Lunges toward the side glass, knee tracking over the toes: 3 sets of 8.
role_drills.every: Lateral shuffles between cones: 4 runs of 6 metres each way.

tests.retest_note: Read this alongside Hip Adduction: the balance between the two matters as much as either number.

tests.name: Hip Adduction Strength
tests.what_we_measured: The strength of the inner thigh (groin) muscles that pull your leg back toward the middle, on each side.

role_lines.drive: Pulling yourself back to the centre after a wide ball uses these muscles. Strong adductors mean a faster recovery step.
role_lines.reves: Deep lunges and splits to reach balls in the corner stretch the groin under load. That's when strains happen.
role_lines.every: Groin strains are common in sports with sudden sideways stops. A strong groin, roughly as strong as the outer hip, is the best protection.

rules.text: Adduction less than 80% of abduction on the same side (proposed) → show Fix A: strengthen the groin.
One side more than 10% weaker than the other (proposed) → also show Fix B: close the gap.
Balanced and even → show Fix C: maintain.

A.title: strengthen the groin
exercises: Copenhagen plank, short lever (knee on the bench): 3 holds of 15–20 seconds each side.
Side-lying inner leg raises: 3 sets of 12 each side.
Ball squeezes between the knees: 3 holds of 10 seconds.

B.title: close the gap
exercises: One extra set on your weaker side for each exercise.

C.title: maintain
exercises: Copenhagen plank twice a week: 2 holds of 20 seconds each side.

role_drills.drive: Lateral lunge and push back to centre: 3 sets of 8 each side.
role_drills.reves: Controlled wide lunges into the corner, slow on the way down: 3 sets of 6.
role_drills.every: Warm up your groin with leg swings side to side before every match: 10 each leg.
